_readme: JoJo's Blocks — BROWSER GAMES IN DEVELOPMENT (UI/UX Pass 2 deployment prep, 16 Nov 2026). Single source of truth for the games listed on /games/. WORKING TITLES ONLY — final names, thumbnails and gameplay are supplied and approved by the owner after development; do not invent them. Every game here has status 'coming-soon': it renders as a card with a neutral thumbnail tile (category icon only, no fake screenshot, no invented artwork), no Play button and no link. NO individual game page is generated for a coming-soon game, and no game appears in the sitemap. When a game is actually ready, set status to 'ready' and give it a slug + thumbnail + metaDescription; the generator then emits games/<slug>/index.html from templates/game.html and lists it in the sitemap.
